narr: A tropical airmass overhead contributed to localized flash flooding in eastern MA in the early morning hours. Many roads were closed due to flooding, including both directions of I-93 near Braintree where cars got stuck in water.
ev: In Quincy, significant flooding was occurring on the southeast Expressway.
In Walpole, a car was stuck in flooding in front of Town Hall.
In Braintree, the off ramp of the southern Rotary was flooded and impassable.
In Sharon, significant street flooding was reported on Canton St, Norwood St, Hampton Rd by Oak Hill Dr, and on Dean St at the railroad bridge. A car was stuck in flooding on Commercial St.
In Randolph, north Main St. by Forest St was flooded and impassable.
In Milton, Lincoln St was flooded and impassable.
In Hull, Nantasket Ave was closed due to flooding.
In Milton, flooding on I-93 southbound was up to the guardrail.
In Quincy, I-93 northbound was closed due to flooding in the Furnace Brook area.
In Weymouth, several vehicles were stranded in flood waters.
In Braintree the Red Line T service was suspended between Quincy Adams and Braintree stops due to flooding.
In Hingham, portions of East St (Rt 228) and Hersey St were flooded.
In Weymouth, a car was stranded due to flooding at the intersection of Prince St and Lake St. The Weymouth Landing area was closed due to flooding.
In Cohasset, Route 3A at Lower King St was closed.
